description: Where the party went, session by session. Each session starts where the previous one ended. A stop is a place id, or an object: { place } or { at: [lng, lat], label }, plus optional flags: approx (a guess: drawn dashed), cross (reached cross-country: a straight line, not by road), pass (only steers the route onto a road: no dot), note (shown on the session page). Legs between stops follow the roads, like Directions. The last stop should match current_location in party.json.
